style_guide: Softly painterly, cinematic illustration with gentle brushwork texture, like a contemporary devotional painting that meets quiet modern realism. Palette: deep indigo and midnight blue shadows balanced by warm amber, saffron and soft gold light. Accents are limited to sattva white-gold, rajas crimson-orange and tamas deep indigo, used symbolically. Lighting is low-key and tender, with small warm practical light sources (diyas, lamps, dawn) against cool ambient blues. Mood is calm, compassionate and contemplative, never anxious or dramatic. Composition: a single clear focal subject, shallow depth of field, 50mm-equivalent intimate framing, generous negative space in the upper or lower third for text added in editing. Compose the 4:5 master with the key subject centred so a 9:16 vertical extension or crop keeps it intact. Krishna and Arjuna appear only in reverent traditional Indian iconography in the classical miniature and devotional painting manner. No text, letters or logos in any image. No identifiable people, faces of real persons or political symbols.

assets.prompt: Cinematic, softly painterly night scene in a dim bedroom at 1 a.m. Two anonymous hands, faces out of frame, hold a glowing smartphone above rumpled cream-and-grey sheets. The phone screen shows only abstract, blurred sunrise gradients and indistinct shapes of a tidy kitchen, with no people visible. Cool blue screen light falls on the fingers and sheets, contrasting with the warm amber glow of a small bedside lamp in the soft-focus background. Close, slightly overhead 50mm framing with shallow depth of field and the phone at centre. Clear negative space at the top of the frame. Palette is indigo, slate blue and warm amber. The mood is quiet, tender and intimate, not anxious.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, words, readable UI, app logos, watermark, identifiable faces, real people, celebrity likeness, social media brand icons, harsh glare, anxious or dark horror mood, clutter, distorted hands, extra fingers

assets.prompt: Reverent traditional painting in the style of classical Indian miniature and devotional art. Lord Krishna has a serene blue complexion, a gentle compassionate expression, a golden crown with a peacock feather, a yellow pitambara silk garment and jewelled ornaments. He sits as charioteer on an ornate golden chariot drawn by four white horses and turns gently toward Arjuna. Arjuna sits respectfully with folded hands, wearing traditional ornate armour and a crown, his bow Gandiva resting at his side. Soft golden dawn light falls across the scene. The Kurukshetra armies appear only as a hazy, distant line of banners on a misty horizon. The composition is a balanced medium-wide view with the chariot in the lower two-thirds and an open pale-gold sky above. Fine detailing, flat decorative perspective blended with soft painterly light. Palette of lapis blue, saffron, gold, ivory and soft rose. The mood is dignified, calm and sacred.

assets.prompt: Elegant painterly still life on a dark, polished wooden surface. Three traditional brass oil lamps (diyas) stand in a horizontal row, evenly spaced. The left lamp burns with a clear, tall, steady white-gold flame. The middle lamp has a vivid, flickering red-orange flame with a slight dancing motion. The right lamp holds a low, deep ember glowing faintly in shadow. Beneath the lamps, three silk threads in white, crimson and deep indigo weave together into a single braid running across the frame. The background is soft black-indigo darkness with subtle warm bokeh. The camera is at a low, eye-level angle with a 50mm lens and shallow depth of field. Negative space above the lamps. Lighting is warm, symbolic and serene, with gentle reflections on the brass.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, symbols, watermark, people, hands, faces, fire hazard, smoke clouds, chaotic flames, modern candles, plastic, clutter, harsh lighting, oversaturated colours

assets.prompt: Painterly cinematic still life. A single square framed photograph stands upright on a wooden desk, in sharp focus, showing a tranquil golden sunrise over perfectly still water. Around it, softly out of focus, lies an ordinary lived-in desk: a cluttered spiral notebook with loose pages, a half-finished cup of tea with a faint ring stain, scattered keys and a tangled charging cable. Gentle warm morning light comes from a side window, with cooler indigo shadows on the desk. Medium close-up at a 50mm, eye-level angle with shallow depth of field isolating the frame. Negative space above. Palette is soft gold and peach in the photo against muted browns, greys and blue in the surroundings. The mood is honest, gentle and reflective.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, handwriting legible, brand logos, watermark, people, faces, hands, celebrity likeness, messy dramatic chaos, harsh light, dark gloomy mood

assets.prompt: Soft painterly wide landscape showing a single continuous sky passing through three moods from left to right. Clear, luminous golden-white light sits on the left. Wind-swept crimson and orange clouds swirl through the middle. Deep, quiet indigo dusk with a few faint stars settles on the right. The transitions blend seamlessly. Below, on a gentle grassy hill, one small lone tree stands rooted and unchanged at the centre of the frame, lit softly by all three skies. A low horizon gives the sky two-thirds of the frame. The tree is centred so a vertical crop keeps it. Painterly brush texture. The mood is calm, steady and contemplative.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, people, animals, buildings, storms with lightning, dramatic disaster, harsh contrast, photorealistic HDR, clutter

assets.prompt: Warm painterly night scene. Two small handmade clay diyas sit side by side on a wooden windowsill. The left flame is steady and upright, and the right flame flickers gently. Their warm amber glows overlap softly into one shared halo on the pale wall behind. Beyond the window glass is a quiet city at night in deep indigo, with scattered warm-lit apartment windows suggesting many lives, softly blurred. Close-up, eye-level 50mm framing with the diyas in the lower third and the city bokeh filling the upper frame. Palette is indigo, amber and soft gold. The mood is gentle, companionable and compassionate.

assets.prompt: Minimal, serene painterly image of a bedside table at night. A smartphone lies face-down beside a single small clay diya glowing softly with a steady warm flame, and an open book with blank cream pages. Silvery moonlight falls through sheer white curtains, casting soft diagonal light across the scene. The composition is uncluttered, with the objects grouped in the lower third and ample empty indigo negative space above for text added in editing. Eye-level 50mm framing with gentle depth of field. Palette is deep indigo and moonlit blue with warm gold accents. The mood is restful, peaceful and quietly hopeful.
